json_ld_descriptions: Huber & Palsir, LLC is a Philadelphia trial law firm handling workers' compensation and personal injury cases for injured workers and accident victims across Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Founded in 2007 by attorney Robert Huber, the firm offers free consultations.

Founding partner of Huber & Palsir, LLC with 35 years representing injury victims in Philadelphia and Eastern Pennsylvania. A 1990 graduate of Villanova University School of Law, he is licensed in Pennsylvania and New Jersey, has obtained several seven-figure verdicts and settlements, and has been selected to the Pennsylvania Super Lawyers list every year since 2012.

Associate attorney at Huber & Palsir, LLC, licensed in Pennsylvania. A 2022 graduate of Penn State Dickinson Law, he previously served as Associate Staff Counsel with the Pennsylvania State Education Association, practicing labor, education, and employment law.
